conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Technical support.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Jennifer from tech support. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Jennifer. My router keeps going offline. Like, it'll work for a while then just disconnect and I have to restart it every time.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That sounds like a hardware issue. How old is your router?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Um, maybe like five years old? So it's pretty old I guess.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That's probably it. Routers have a lifespan. I can send you a replacement at no cost since you're a long-time customer.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Sales department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: David here. What can I help you with?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi David. I'm looking at switching mobile providers. I'm currently with another company but their rates are getting ridiculously high.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: We're very competitive. How many lines do you currently have?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Just two lines. One for me and one for my wife. We both need pretty good coverage since we travel for work.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: We have excellent coverage nationwide. Would you like to hear more details?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Account services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Emily here. What can I do?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Emily. I need to update my phone number on the account. I just got a new cell number.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Sure. What's your new number?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: All updated! We'll use this number for any communications from now on.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Mark from billing. What's the issue?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah, I got charged like 50 dollars in overage fees this month. I didn't think I was going over my data limit. This doesn't make sense.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Let me check your usage. I see you did go over. You used about 30 GB extra.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: That seems like a lot. I don't really stream that much. Is there a way to upgrade my plan instead?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Absolutely. I can upgrade you to unlimited data. It would be just a few dollars more per month.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Technical support.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Susan from tech support. What's going on?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Susan. I'm trying to set up my email through your service but I can't figure out the settings. I have Outlook on my computer.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: No problem. I can walk you through it. First, what email address are you using?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: It's john.smith at telecomhaiku dot com.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Good. Go to settings and I'll tell you what server information to enter.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Customer service.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Daniel from retention. I see you're having concerns?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah. My bill keeps going up. I'm paying like 150 dollars a month now and it was way less when I signed up. I'm thinking about leaving.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I understand that's frustrating. Let me see what promotions we might have available.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Unfortunately our current promotions don't apply to your account type. But let me get a manager to see if we can do something.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Sales.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Rachel from sales. How are you doing today?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Pretty good. I'm interested in bundling my services. I currently have broadband with you guys but I want to add mobile.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Perfect! Bundling with your existing broadband would save you money. How many mobile lines do you need?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Just one for now. My wife already has a line with another provider but maybe she'll switch too eventually.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Great. I'll get you set up with the bundle pricing right away.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Kevin from billing. What do you need?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Kevin. I was charged for a service I cancelled like two months ago. Can I get a refund for those charges?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Let me look at that. I can see where you cancelled it. Those charges shouldn't have been applied.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Okay good. So what happens now?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I'm processing a refund. You should see it in your account within 3-5 business days.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Technical support.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Patricia here. What's wrong with your service?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: My modem is making this weird clicking sound and sometimes the lights go out randomly. It's probably dying. I think I need a replacement.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That does sound like a hardware failure. A replacement modem is on the way to you at no charge.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Great, how long will that take?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: It should arrive within 3-5 business days. Once you get it, just unplug the old one and plug in the new one. It's really straightforward.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Telecom Haiku customer service.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: James here. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi James. I'm looking at possibly switching to Telecom Haiku and I wanted to know what kind of services you offer in my area.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: We offer broadband, mobile, TV, and bundles. What's your location?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I'm in the downtown area of Springdale.
